title: onboarding-access-matrix-and-skill-swap-checklist-10day
body:
Purpose:
This is a working playbook for a condensed 10-day onboarding focused on: rapid access provisioning, skill-swap pairing (peer shadowing), and explicit sign-off rubrics so new associates can ship low-risk changes and be oncall-ready for basic tasks.

Intended audience:
- People Ops (owner)
- Hiring manager / Manager of record
- Buddy / Skill-swap partner
- Infrastructure / SRE / IAM owners for systems listed below

High-level goals (success metrics):
- First PR merged within 7 days (non-prod) or 10 days (prod-facing)
- 100% of essential access granted by EOD day 2
- Buddy shadow sessions completed (4 x 60m) and checklist signed by day 10
- Handoff rubric score >= 8/12 for technical readiness

Quick notes / constraints:
- This is an aggressive stream for roles that already have basic infra experience (associate / junior -> mid). Use the 30/60/90 if role is senior or cross-functional.
- Where security policy blocks auto-provisioning, escalate to IAM-sla@redwood with tag JIRA-PEOPLE-802.
- Keep manual exceptions minimal and timeboxed.

Access matrix (essential systems only) - grant level shorthand: R(read), W(write), A(admin), S(sudo), T(temporary)
Role | System | Level of access | Owner | Day to grant
New Associate | GitHub (repo: product/*) | R -> W (branch) | Dev Tools | Day 0-1
New Associate | Jira (project: ENG-INF) | W (create/transition) | Eng Ops | Day 0-1
New Associate | CI (buildkite) | R -> trigger | Release Eng | Day 1
New Associate | Staging cluster (k8s) | R / namespace dev | Infra | Day 1-2
New Associate | Production cluster | T(safe-ops) only with mentor | SRE | Day 8-10 (after sign-off)

10-day checklist (day-by-day working sprint) - to be filled by hiring manager and buddy
Day 0 (pre-first-day):
- HR / People Ops sends welcome packet + required forms (Aisha)
- IAM request pre-seeded for core items (GitHub, Jira, Slack) with owner tags
- Manager assigns buddy and schedules a 30m intro call

Day 1: orientation + baseline access
- Confirm GitHub + Jira + Slack access (check list column)
- Local dev environment checklist (node/python/tooling) installed 
- Walkthrough: repo map and dev loop (buddy)
- Quick security review (1 pager)

Day 2: infra access + first ticket
- Stage namespace created and tested (pull/push image)
- Assign first small starter ticket (doc fix, minor test)
- Schedule 4x buddy shadow sessions across week

Day 3-4: pair programming 
- Pair on starter ticket and CI pipeline tweak
- Buddy completes "observed feedback" note in candidate doc

Day 5: independent PR and retro
- New associate lands a PR that passes CI without owner rework
- Manager/buddy retro: 30m focused on blockers and access gaps

Day 6-7: deeper systems + runbook reading
- Read two runbooks (deploy checklist + oncall triage)
- Small infra-change simulated in staging (configmap change)

Day 8-9: skill-swap sign-off prep
- Runthrough of a production-safe play under mentor observation (read-only audit or metric dashboard instrumentation)
- Security checklist completed (2FA, KMS access recorded)

Day 10: formal sign-off & next steps
- Buddy and manager complete the sign-off rubric (below)
- Access escalation: if production access required, approve T-sudo for 48h scope and pair ops session scheduled
- Add to rotation shadow list for next 30 days

Skill-swap pairing mechanics:
- Pairings last minimum 10 days as core shadow and 30 days as async handoff (notes + watchlist)
- Expectations: newcomer to lead 2 sessions; buddy to document two "how-to" clips (5-7m each)
- Use shared doc: linked_artifacts CONFLUENCE-ONBOARD-3432 as canonical template

Sign-off rubric (flat scoring, out of 12):
- Repo familiarity (0-3): branch + PR + review understanding
- CI comfort (0-3): can read buildkite logs and rerun jobs
- Staging deploy (0-2): can trigger safe deploy to namespace
- Incident triage baseline (0-2): understands playbook for pager noise + where to escalate
- Communication (0-2): posts status updates in channel, creates clear ticket summaries
Pass target: >= 8 and no critical gaps in security items.

Acceptance / escalation rules:
- If essential access not granted by end of Day 2 -> create JIRA-PEOPLE-802 with priority P1 and tag IAM owner
- If rubric < 6 at day 10 -> extend onboarding buddy by 14 days and create targeted learning plan

Notes to people-ops (TODOs):
- [ ] Automate the "Day 0 pre-seed" via SCIM -> ticket mapped to manager (owner: Aisha)
- [ ] Build a short video for runbook reading summarizing the deploy checklist (owner: Marco)
- [ ] Validate KMS onboarding with security for private-key handling in Private deployments (owner: Sofia)

Edge cases / special roles:
- Platform engineers: require additional approvals for infra admin; use 30-day plan.
- Customer-facing roles (solutions/CS): grant only mock-prod tokens until security sign-off.

Appendix - sample messages
- Slack template to request pre-seed access:
  "@iam-team please pre-seed access for new hire: Aisha Patel, GitHub: aisha.patel@redwood, repos: product/*, jira: ENG-INF. Please tag owner and confirm ETA."

- Manager sign-off message template (day 10):
  "I confirm that NAME has met onboarding targets per the 10-day matrix. Sign-off score: X/12. Approved production temp access: yes/no. Next steps: add to rotation shadow list."

Unresolved questions (for review cycle):
- Should we require mandatory documented pair-led deploy on Day 9 for all roles that will touch prod? pros/cons? (bring to People Ops review 2026-01-18)
- How to reduce IAM owner friction when entire team is remote across regions?

Revision history:
- 2025-11-05 created by Aisha Patel (initial outline)
- 2025-12-10 feedback from Marco (added sign-off rubric)
- 2026-01-12 updated with escalation rules and linked artifacts
